title: Progella, Pagara complete comeback vs China to clinch Asiad bronze in women's beach volley
summary: Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara completed their comeback against their Chinese opponents, 13-21, 23-21, 15-13, to win the bronze medal in the women's beach volleyball tournament of the 20th Asian…

blocks.text: Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara completed their comeback against their Chinese opponents, 13-21, 23-21, 15-13, to win the bronze medal in the women's beach volleyball tournament of the 20th Asian Games on Friday at the Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court.
